name: gitgui-workspace
description: GitGui Electron, SvelteKit, TypeScript, and Rust workspace

scripts.build: npm run protocol:generate && npm run build -w @gitgui/web
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build -w @gitgui/ssh && npm run build -w @gitgui/desktop
scripts.web:serve: npm run build && cargo run -p gitgui-server -- --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 3774 --repository . --web-dir apps/web/build
scripts.check: npm run protocol:generate && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: node --test scripts/vendor-t3code.test.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && cargo test --workspace
scripts.electron:package: npm run server:prepare -- --release && npm run build && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml
